purpose: Judge identity and outfit preservation, physically integrated liquid chrome, believable reflections, clean subject visibility, and premium fashion-editorial finish against six gathered examples.

examples.title: Liquid chrome turns one street portrait into a campaign
whyItWorks: The red jacket, denim, hood, pose, and street camera remain recognizable
Chrome ribbons cast believable reflections and wrap around the scene without covering the subject

examples.title: A mirror selfie keeps its clothes and casual posture
whyItWorks: The phone, shopping bag, layered outfit, cap, and proportions survive the transformation
Liquid-metal sculpture grows through the boutique with useful depth and contact shadows

examples.title: Soft knit texture stays legible beside hard chrome
whyItWorks: The green dress, boots, bag, crossed arms, and face stay clear
Chrome branches curve behind and around the body instead of flattening into a backdrop

examples.title: A layered fashion look survives the surreal set
whyItWorks: Hair, shoulder pose, mini dress, bag, and tall boots keep their original color and shape
Foreground and background chrome create real depth without swallowing the person

examples.title: Busy city context still reads through the effect
whyItWorks: The cap, layered jacket, jewelry, jeans, backpack straps, and gaze remain intact
Reflections and occlusion place the chrome sculpture convincingly on the sidewalk

examples.title: Graphic clothing and accessories stay untouched
whyItWorks: The glasses, cup, knit graphics, baggy pants, shoes, and full pose remain recognizable
The metallic forms add spectacle without replacing the original street portrait
